environment: Ubuntu 24.04 virtual runner, Linux 6.17.0-1022-azure, BIRD 2.14, IPVS 1.31
sync: both native IPVS master and backup daemons on each director, same dedicated link and sync ID; no role swap
mapping: one established TCP mapping present on both directors before failover and failback
limit: One short virtual two-node trial with one retained socket. No sync storms, larger state tables, link loss after replication, resource ceiling, hardware, or production SLO qualification.
